# Jamaur Johnson

> Jamaur Johnson (aka Suess Villiano in music, bka META SV) is a Wilmington-born founder, AI automation architect, trader, author, and music creator. He builds digital ecosystems — LIV8, LIV8AI, Hybrid Funding, Trade Hybrid — that combine AI, automation, finance, media, and education into scalable platforms designed to give people generational leverage.

## Identity

- **Legal name:** Jamaur Johnson
- **Music alias:** Suess Villiano
- **Creative alias / brand short form:** META SV
- **Hometown:** Wilmington, Delaware, USA
- **Based:** Operates as a digital nomad (Miami, Orlando, Tampa, Las Vegas, Atlanta)
- **Family:** Father of three sons

## What he does

- **Founder:** Builds companies, SaaS platforms, and digital infrastructure
- **AI Automation Architect:** Designs intelligent agents and automation systems on top of GoHighLevel, custom AI, and modern tooling
- **Trader / FinTech Builder:** Active markets, funded-trader infrastructure, prop firm operations
- **Author:** Trading, consciousness, strategy, and the future
- **Music Creator:** Original music and instrumentals under Suess Villiano / META SV

## Education

- Caravel Academy (Wilmington, DE) — All-State wide receiver
- West Chester University — partial football scholarship
- University of Delaware — business studies
- Wilmington University — business studies

## Core themes

- Ecosystems, not projects — every venture is a thread in one larger fabric
- Four kinds of leverage: financial, technological, informational, generational
- Family-first — building systems his three sons can step into
- Builder + visionary — operator energy paired with long-range vision
- Technology should enhance human potential, not replace it
